raw_output:
Giver: Hi, can you hear me?
Follower: Yeah, I can hear you fine.
Giver: Okay. Let's do this. You have the map here?
Follower: Yep, got it.
Giver: Good. We're going to draw a route from START to FINISH. Follow my instructions exactly and draw a line on your map.
Follower: Understood.
Giver: Start at the cross marked START. From there, head right and slightly down.
Follower: Okay.
Giver: Go until you're just above the sandy shore. Then turn left.
Follower: I'm doing that now.
Giver: Turn left again, aiming towards the well.
Follower: Right, passing the well on my left.
Giver: Good. Continue straight for a bit, then make a sharp right angle.
Follower: Done.
Giver: Now head towards the local residents.
Follower: Wait, I don't see the local residents there.
Giver: What? I just told you to go towards them.
Follower: I see them further down the path, past where you want me to go. I think they're not where you think they are.
Giver: That's weird. Just follow the well and keep going left until you hit the residents.
Follower: Okay, heading to the residents now.
Giver: Once you're near the residents, turn right towards the crane bay.
Follower: I don't see the crane bay. I only see the residents.
Giver: The crane bay is just past the residents on your map, right?
Follower: No, I don't see it at all. Maybe it's not on my map?
Giver: It's there. Just keep going left after the residents, and you'll see it.
Follower: Okay, continuing left. Wait, I'm confused. Should I go past the residents or stop there?
Giver: Go past the residents. Turn right towards the crane bay.
Follower: Okay, turning right. Wait, I see something else. There's an iron bridge here, but I don't see a crane bay.
Giver: Ignore the bridge. Just head towards the crane bay.
Follower: I can't find the crane bay. It's not on my map.
Giver: That's strange. Okay, forget the crane bay. Just keep going left until you hit the forked stream.
Follower: Okay, heading left. I see the forked stream.
Giver: Good. Turn right at the stream.
Follower: Done.
Giver: Now head towards the farmed land.
Follower: Wait, there's no farmed land there. I see a mountain stream.
Giver: Just keep going. The farmed land is right next to the mountain stream on your map.
Follower: Oh, okay. I see the farmed land now. Heading there.
Giver: Once you're at the farmed land, turn left.
Follower: Okay, turning left.
Giver: Head towards the dead tree.
Follower: I see the dead tree. Turning towards it.
Giver: Good. Pass the dead tree and keep going left.
Follower: Wait, I don't see the lagoon you mentioned. I only see the lagoon further down.
Giver: The lagoon is right there. Turn right at the lagoon.
Follower: Okay, turning right at the lagoon.
Giver: Head towards the rockfall.
Follower: I see the rockfall. Heading there.
Giver: Pass the rockfall and turn left.
Follower: Okay, turning left.
Giver: Head towards the pirate ship.
Follower: I see the pirate ship. Turning towards it.
Giver: Good. Pass the pirate ship and turn right.
Follower: Wait, I don't see a pirate ship there. I only see a computer controlled sub.
Giver: The pirate ship is right there. Just past the sub.
Follower: Oh, I see it now. Turning right.
Giver: Now head towards the green bay.
Follower: I see the green bay. Heading there.
Giver: Once you're at the green bay, turn left.
Follower: Okay, turning left.
Giver: Head towards the FINISH.
Follower: I see the FINISH. Done.
Giver: Great. Did you get it?
Follower: Yep, looks like it.
Giver: Perfect. Thanks.
Follower: No problem.
